meta.name: Monochrome editorial reference tokens
meta.source: Official X Business live computed styles, verified 2026-09-06; project recommendations are marked in descriptions.
meta.font_note: The live source uses proprietary-hosted xVF/xVFDisplay. These tokens intentionally use only explicit system fallbacks.
meta.source_of_truth: Edit this JSON and run python3 scripts/build-release.py; CSS token files are generated.
